intro: A community-first event app designed to make finding the next game feel effortless, social and local.
carousel_hint: Drag or use the arrows to explore
slide_1_text: Browse nearby events and join the moments that fit your week.
slide_2_text: A map view turns a city into an open invitation to play.
slide_3_text: Save favourites and come back when the time is right.
slide_4_text: A clean event flow that makes joining a game feel easy.
outro_text: The product keeps every important choice visible, then gets out of the way so people can meet, move and belong.

seo.seo_description: A Playtribe product showcase by Sara Ruffini.
